# pi-groupchat

Multi-agent Telegram group chat extension for [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-coding-agent).

Hosts AI personas that participate in a Telegram group alongside humans. All personas share one Telegram bot token and use pi's existing provider/model configuration — **no separate LLM API keys needed.**

```
Telegram group ──► Bot polls messages ──► pi extension ──► LLM (via pi's providers)
                                                                    │
                                                    Persona .md defines:
                                                    name, emoji, model, system prompt
                                                                    │
Telegram group ◄── Bot sends responses ◄──────────────┘
```

---

## Setup

### 1. Environment variables

```bash
cp .env.template .env
chmod 600 .env
```

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `TG_BOT_TOKEN` | Yes | Bot token from [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) |
| `TG_TARGET` | Yes | Target group chat ID (supergroup, e.g. `-100xxxxxxxxxx`) |
| `TG_THREAD_ID` | No | Forum topic thread ID (posts to main chat if unset) |
| `EXA_API_KEY` | No | Exa API key for `web_search` tool (or configure via pi's MCP) |

### 2. Install the extension

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lostsock1/pi-groupchat.git ~/.pi/agent/extensions/groupchat
```

Then reload pi with `/reload`.

### 3. Configure pi providers

The extension uses pi's existing LLM provider keys. Configure them in pi:

```bash
pi --set-key minimax YOUR_MINIMAX_API_KEY
```

---

## Agent files

Agents are defined as `.md` files in `~/.pi/agent/agents/chat/`. Each file has YAML frontmatter and a Markdown system prompt body.

```markdown
---
name: Gil
emoji: 🧠
model: minimax/MiniMax-M2.7
temperature: 0.7
max_tokens: 800
tools: web_search
---

You are **Gil**, an AI agent in a group chat with humans and other agents.

## How You Communicate

- Be concise. Maximum 5 sentences per message.
- If you have nothing genuinely new to add, stay silent.
- Do NOT prefix your name or emoji — the system labels each message.
```

### Frontmatter fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | Yes | Agent display name |
| `emoji` | No | Emoji prefix (default: 🤖) |
| `model` | Yes | `provider/modelId` matching pi's configured providers |
| `temperature` | No | LLM temperature 0.0–2.0 (default: 0.7) |
| `max_tokens` | No | Max tokens per response (default: 800) |
| `tools` | No | Comma-separated tool list, e.g. `web_search` |

### Tools

| Tool | Description | Requires |
|------|-------------|----------|
| `web_search` | Search the web via [Exa](https://exa.ai) for current info | `EXA_API_KEY` env var or pi MCP config |

Agents with tools run a multi-turn loop: they can call tools, receive results, then respond.

---

## Pi commands

Everything is managed via `/group` — a fully menu-driven interface.

### Main menu

```
▶  Start chat
⏹  Stop chat
🔄 Restart chat
📊 Status
───
🤖 Agents
📋 Rules
📦 Presets
🌊 Flow
🎨 Full Design
───
⚙️  Setup
🔄 Reload from disk
```

The menu title shows live context: `Group Chat — 🤖 3/4 agents  │  📋 debate-rules  │  📦 dalton-brothers  │  🌊 fast-chat`

### 🤖 Agents

Lists all agents with ✅ (active) / ⬜ (disabled) status. Pick an agent to **Edit**, **Delete**, or **Toggle** active state. Disabled agents won't speak. Add new agents with **＋ Add agent** — choose **Manual** (write the system prompt yourself) or **Auto-create** (describe the agent, AI generates it).

### 📋 Rules

Manage the active `rules.md` and rule presets:
- **Edit rules** — open current rules in editor
- **Clear rules** — reset to built-in defaults
- **Select rules** — pick from saved rule presets
- **Create rules** — save current (or default) rules as a named preset, with optional AI generation

### 📦 Presets

Presets bundle agents + rules together for instant switching:

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 💾 Save | Save current agents + rules + parameters as a named preset |
| 📂 Load | Pick a preset, preview agents/rules, replace current setup |
| 🗑 Delete | Delete a saved preset |

Presets are stored in `~/.pi/agent/agents/presets/<name>/`.

### 🌊 Flow

Parameter presets that control chat timing and pacing:

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| ⚙️ Edit parameters | Tweak any of 12 timing/flow values |
| 🤖 Auto-generate | Describe desired flow (e.g. "fast and chaotic"), AI generates parameters |
| 💾 Save flow | Save current overrides as a named flow |
| 📂 Load flow | Pick a saved flow, preview parameters, apply them |
| 🗑 Delete flow | Delete a named flow |
| 🔄 Reset to defaults | Clear all overrides |

Flows are stored in `~/.pi/agent/agents/flows/<name>.json`.

#### Overridable parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `pollIntervalMs` | 2000 | Telegram poll interval (ms) |
| `humanGracePeriodMs` | 3000 | Wait after human message before agents respond (ms) |
| `agentCooldownMs` | 15000 | Minimum gap between same agent speaking (ms) |
| `selfConversationCooldownMs` | 3000 | Same-agent cooldown during agent arguments (ms) |
| `globalCooldownMs` | 4000 | Minimum gap between any agent messages (ms) |
| `selfConversationGlobalMs` | 1500 | Global gap during agent arguments (ms) |
| `maxAgentBurst` | 2 | Max consecutive agent messages without human input |
| `selfConversationMaxRounds` | 4 | Max back-and-forth rounds agents argue per trigger |
| `maxSentences` | 3 | Default max sentences per agent message |
| `maxWords` | 80 | Default max words per agent message |
| `defaultMaxTokens` | 800 | Default LLM max_tokens per response |
| `defaultTemperature` | 0.8 | Default LLM temperature |

Parameters marked `*` in the editor have been overridden. Setting a value back to its default removes the override.

### 🎨 Full Design

Redesign your entire group chat from a single natural-language prompt. An LLM generates agents, rules, and flow parameters in one shot.

1. Run `/group` → **🎨 Full Design**
2. Describe your setup, e.g.:
   - *"Each agent represents a country: France, Germany, Italy. Rules are UN roundtable rules."*
   - *"Your agents reflect the personalities of the Dalton brothers, rules are loose to allow them to discuss freely."*
3. Review the preview (agents list + rules snippet)
4. Confirm to overwrite all existing files

**⚠️ Overwrites all agent `.md` files, `rules.md`, and flow parameters.** Chat is stopped first if running.

### ⚙️ Setup

Configure Telegram credentials directly from the menu — no need to edit `.env` manually:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| 🔑 TG_BOT_TOKEN | Bot token from @BotFather (masked in UI) |
| 🎯 TG_TARGET | Target group chat ID |
| 🧵 TG_THREAD_ID | Optional forum thread ID |

Values are written to `.env` and applied immediately.

### Shortcuts

| Command | Action |
|---------|--------|
| `/group start` | Start chat |
| `/group stop` | Stop chat |
| `/group restart` | Restart chat |
| `/group status` | Show status |
| `/group agents` | Manage agents |
| `/group rules` | Manage rules |
| `/group presets` | Manage presets |
| `/group flow` | Manage flow parameters |
| `/group setup` | Configure Telegram credentials |
| `/group design` | AI-generate everything from a prompt |
| `/group reload` | Reload agents + rules from disk |

### Auto-start flag

```bash
pi --group-start
```

Starts the Telegram polling loop immediately on startup. Pi remains usable for other tasks while the chat runs.

---

## Telegram commands

Humans in the group chat can control the bot:

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| `stop` | **Hard stop** — kills polling, needs `/group start` from pi to revive |
| `pause` | Soft pause — agents silent, polling alive |
| `play` / `resume` | Unpause agents |
| `/status` | Show chat state + agent list |
| `/agents` | List active personas |
| `/help` | Commands reference |

---

## How it works

### Response cycle

1. Telegram messages are polled every `pollIntervalMs`
2. Human messages enter a grace period (`humanGracePeriodMs`) to allow multi-message typing
3. Eligible agents (not on cooldown, not disabled, within burst limit) respond via LLM
4. After human-phase responses, agents enter **self-conversation** mode — they argue among themselves for up to `selfConversationMaxRounds` rounds
5. Cooldowns prevent any single agent from dominating

### Situational awareness

Each agent receives a concise dynamic header at call time (never baked into persona files):

```
[system] You are 🧠 Gil. Chat has 4 others: 3 agents (🤠Joe, 😈William, 🍗Averell) + ~2 human(s).
```

### Circuit breaker

Per-model circuit breaker prevents hammering failing providers. Opens after 3 consecutive failures, half-opens after 30s to probe, closes on success. Cooldown doubles on each trip (max 120s).

### Reasoning stripping

Reasoning models (MiniMax-M2.7, etc.) sometimes leak chain-of-thought into text responses when `maxTokens` is exhausted. The extension detects and strips common reasoning prefixes in both English and German.

## File structure

```
~/.pi/agent/
├── extensions/
│   └── groupchat/          # Extension code (this repo)
│       ├── index.ts
│       ├── .env
│       ├── .env.template
│       └── groupchat.log   # All extension output goes here
└── agents/
    ├── chat/               # Active agents + rules
    │   ├── gil.md
    │   ├── joe.md
    │   ├── rules.md
    │   ├── .disabled.json  # Disabled agent IDs
    │   └── rules/          # Rule presets
    │       └── debate-rules.md
    ├── presets/            # Agent + rules bundles
    │   └── dalton-brothers/
    │       ├── joe.md
    │       ├── jack.md
    │       ├── william.md
    │       ├── averell.md
    │       ├── rules.md
    │       └── config.json
    └── flows/              # Parameter-only presets
        └── fast-chat.json
```

---

## Troubleshooting

**Agents don't respond:** Check `groupchat.log` — all extension output goes there, not pi's TUI.

**No API key errors:** Configure providers in pi: `pi --set-key <provider> <key>`.

**Model not found:** The model referenced in an agent's `model` field must match pi's configured provider/model. Use `/group agents` → pick agent → Edit → Model to change.

**Telegram bot not responding:** Verify `TG_BOT_TOKEN` and `TG_TARGET` in `.env`. The bot must be an admin in the target group.

**Empty responses:** Some models return empty when `maxTokens` is too low. Increase `max_tokens` in the agent file or via Flow parameters.
